recipe.visualDefinition: A two-part vertical composition featuring a stark white header with ultra-bold, high-contrast serif typography above a moody, sepia-toned cinematic portrait with dramatic chiaroscuro lighting.
coreVisualRelationships: Sharp geometric typography vs. soft organic portraiture
Bright white header vs. dark atmospheric background
Tight vertical cropping of text vs. expansive negative space in image
coreInvariants: Horizontal dividing line between text and image
Warm, amber-heavy color palette in the lower section

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is positioned in the lower-left quadrant, leaning diagonally toward the center, occupying approximately 40% of the lower frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large-scale black text against the white background at the top.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the bold header, moves down to the subject's face, then follows the diagonal lean into the dark negative space on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant dark negative space on the right side of the portrait creates a sense of mystery and depth.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep amber and burnt sienna (portrait background)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast in the header; low value, high saturation warmth in the portrait.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to warm earth tones and monochrome

letterConstructionRules: Extreme contrast between thick and thin strokes
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for maximum impact; no secondary type.
graphicDevices: Horizontal rule separating header from image

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the extreme weight and hairline serifs.
Provides the classic high-fashion editorial look.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a moody 1970s-style portrait of a woman in a dark dress with a lace collar, leaning diagonally. Use warm amber and sepia lighting with a soft-focus, grainy film texture. Leave the top 20% of the canvas as a solid white bar.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a single word in all-caps using a black, ultra-bold Didone serif font. The text should fill the white bar horizontally with very tight spacing.

verificationChecks: Is the text strictly in the white header area?
Is the lighting in the portrait warm and dramatic?
Does the font have extreme stroke contrast?
Is there a clear horizontal divide?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original subject
postGenerationChecks: Verify the white masthead is clean and separate
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a [Didone Masthead] on a [White Header] with a [Sepia-Toned Soft Focus Portrait] featuring [Dramatic Side Lighting].
